headlines.title: ‘Never Forget’: How Americans remember Sept. 11
headlines.description: From an 11-year-old watching the towers fall on a classroom TV to a doctor treating victims in a conference room, NBC News readers share their searing memories from Sept. 11, 2001.

headlines.title: Hillary Clinton warns the U.S. has let its guard down on terrorism 25 years after 9/11
headlines.description: Former Secretary of State Hillary Clinton warned Thursday that the Trump administration isn’t doing enough to monitor and thwart terrorists who still pose a threat to the U.S., 25 years after the 9/11 attacks.

headlines.title: Diesel hits all-time high of $6 per gallon and just about everything will cost more
headlines.description: “We are endangering one of the strongest economic pillars that we have in this country,” said fourth-generation Iowa farmer Mark Mueller.

headlines.title: August inflation report could set the path for interest rates, affordability
headlines.description: Friday’s August inflation report could mark a pivotal moment for interest rates, affordability and Kevin Warsh, President Donald Trump’s new Fed chairman.

headlines.title: More AI researchers warn of AI's threat to humanity
headlines.description: NBC News' Tom Llamas spoke to two more artificial intelligence researchers about the potential threat A.I has to humanity. This comes after AI researcher Jacob Coxon shared a viral tweet saying he believed AI could kill humanity in the next decade. Llamas also spoke to Incoming Professor at UC Berkley Sayash Kapoor who also warns of risk, but says policy proposals and regulations can help prevent further threats.

headlines.title: Vance honors Charlie Kirk on the anniversary of his death
headlines.description: Vice President JD Vance recognized Charlie Kirk on the first anniversary of his death during his speech at the Republican midterm convention. Vance spoke about how Kirk attended his speech during the 2024 Republican National Convention.

headlines.title: Republicans largely ignore the war in Iran at their midterm convention
headlines.description: Aside from mentions by Trump and top administration officials, speakers at the convention mostly avoided talking about the war.

headlines.title: They led vigils to victims of Tiananmen. Now they’re facing time in prison for it.
headlines.description: Three pro-democracy activists in Hong Kong who organized annual vigils for victims of China’s 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown were sentenced Friday under a national security law that critics say has stifled dissent.

headlines.title: Singer D4vd sued by parents of teen girl he is accused of killing
headlines.description: Celeste Rivas Hernandez’s parents are suing the singer D4vd, accusing him of wrongful death after he was charged in the 14-year-old girl’s murder.

headlines.title: Heart damage may occur from getting too much light at night while we sleep, study finds
headlines.description: Too much light exposure during sleep may lead to potentially harmful changes in the structure and function of the heart, a new study suggests.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.
